positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?

evidence.text: "I'm running for Congress to protect the American dream, secure the border, and put America FIRST!"
"The only reason the border is still a catastrophe is because Democrats in Washington DC want it to be. Texas is doing its duty to protect its citizens."
"There's no national security without border security."

positions.question: Do you support requiring immigrants to return to their country of origin before they are eligible for citizenship, regardless of their immigration status?

evidence.text: "My prayers are with the family of Laken Riley as they mourn the loss of their daughter, who was murdered by an illegal migrant. Illegal immigration doesn't just steal jobs or resources meant for American citizens. It steals the lives of our sons and daughters every day."

"The Senate Amnesty Bill should be DOA. Allows 5,000 illegal immigrants per day. Green card giveaways (magnet for illegal immigration) $2.3 billion for refugee resettlement. More money for foreign borders than our own"

positions.question: Do you support economic intervention as a means of resolving international conflicts?

evidence.text: "Enough foreign aid. Americans need to come first."

"Inflation is still high. Working Americans are struggling to afford basic necessities. Millions of illegals are pouring across our southern border. And Democrats in Washington are still trying to push almost $100 BILLION in foreign aid. We need to put America FIRST!"

positions.question: Do you support the US providing increased offensive military aid to Ukraine?

evidence.text: "American tax dollars belong in America, not in Ukraine."
"I wish people in Washington DC would care about American citizens as much as they care about Ukraine."
"If the federal government actually needed more revenue, they would stop sending billions to Ukraine every week instead of raising our taxes."

positions.question: Do you generally support increased regulations on social media companies (e.g. Tik Tok, Facebook, etc.)?

evidence.text: "Banning TikTok over privacy concerns is great. Let’s repeal the Patriot Act too."
"Be wary of politicians who use TikTok as an excuse to put the Patriot Act on steroids. I don’t want the NSA or FBI in my phone any more than TikTok."

"The far left is not interested in free speech.Big government and big tech are colluding to silence and intimidate Americans into submission to their radical worldview at all costs. Freedom will ALWAYS win over fear!"
